Messages.Body:
Dog wrote:
> Dragos and Watenda are in combat.
>
> Dragos plays a hideous combat card which would cost any normal immortal 2
> blood, but of course he doesn't have to pay.
>
> Watenda wishes to avoid gribbly doom by cancelling the card.
>
> Must Watenda expend blood to do so?

Yes.

Dragos doesn't reduce the cost of the card (unlike, say, Black Cat does
with equipment). Dragos simply doesn't burn any blood to pay the cost.

Watenda would still have to burn blood equal to the cost in order to
counter the effect.
